title: Vesper and the Thorn
author: Beatrix Almeida
blurb: Juniper Quintana, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
